runs.result: TKEY-001..TKEY-006 produced 6/6 alerts in all 4 independent campaigns. In every run, PyNative keyword and positional controls succeeded, while Graph keyword calls failed with unexpected keyword argument errors.
Each keyword variant fails in Graph mode with RuntimeError: Got an unexpected keyword argument for the public Tensor parameter name.
Each positional control succeeds in Graph mode on CPU.
Each keyword variant succeeds in PyNative mode on CPU.
